cells.gaps: No source found says whether any transfer goes without the CNPD's authorisation, or that a list, model terms or a general authorisation is published.
cells.note: Rescored under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (messages-for-bill 58): Law 5-2025 gives the CNPD the power to authorise cross-border transfers [COG-001], which answers question 1. Whether any transfer goes without that permission is not held, so the stage is 2.
